notes.title: Release this week and Multiplayer update
notes.content: [p]Grim Hollow will be available this week. Reminder this is an early access game, so there will be constant updates. [/p][p]Regarding multiplayer, the current map is very small and just for testing for the first week. I attached the image of the map for the multiplayer scene that will available soon in the next update. [/p][p]The map will be very large with over 20 villages/inner cities. Will be added to the single player level soon as well as an optional move from the mainland. [/p][p][/p][p]Please report any bugs or requests/recommendations here. [/p]
